families.status_en: Existing original UI adapter; selected firmware versions verified. Original hardware/kernel boot is not emulated.
families.status_zh: 保留原厂 UI 适配器，指定固件版本已验证；尚未模拟原厂硬件及原厂内核启动。
families.boot_gap_en: Sensor, ISP, lens and camera peripherals are mocked or absent.
families.boot_gap_zh: 传感器、ISP、镜头等相机外设为模拟值或尚未实现。

families.status_en: Offline AES decryption and extraction verified on actual A7 IV 2.00 and A7R V 4.00 packages. Original UI has not booted.
families.status_zh: 真实 A7 IV 2.00 和 A7R V 4.00 升级包已通过 AES 解密与提取；原厂 UI 尚未启动。
families.boot_gap_en: A7 IV original kernel executes but reaches an exception path after an early store to 0xFE005010 (suspected secondary-core boot mailbox). Sony SoC memory map, storage, proprietary IPC and display are missing. No original UI boot verified.
families.boot_gap_zh: A7 IV 原厂内核已执行，早期写 0xFE005010 后进入异常路径，疑似次核启动邮箱；缺索尼 SoC 内存映射、存储、IPC 和显示适配，原厂 UI 未启动。

families.family: GR III / IIIx / IV frame container
families.status_en: Independent bounded decoder verified on GR III, IIIx and IV. Structural ROMFS parsing extracts kernels and device trees; UI boot remains unverified.
families.status_zh: 独立解码器已验证 GR III、IIIx、IV；按 ROMFS 结构提取内核和设备树，UI 尚未启动。
families.boot_gap_en: Milbeaut board emulation for the extracted vendor kernel, RTOS/Linux IPC/shared memory, display and camera services. III/IIIx initramfs extracted; no /initramfs ROMFS file found in the tested IV package. No original system or UI boot verified locally.
families.boot_gap_zh: 已提取原厂内核，仍缺对应 Milbeaut 板级模拟、RTOS/Linux IPC/共享内存、显示和相机服务适配。III/IIIx 已提取 initramfs，实测 IV 包未找到 /initramfs ROMFS 文件；本地原厂系统及 UI 尚未验证启动。

families.family: XOR-table update packages / selected Z models
families.status_en: Six Z-series update packages decrypted and checked. Z7 C3.80 original menu and navigation verified in a separately built custom QEMU, using assisted startup.
families.status_zh: 六份 Z 系列升级包已解密并校验；Z7 C3.80 在单独编译的定制 QEMU 中通过辅助启动显示原厂菜单，导航已验证。
families.boot_gap_en: Keys and custom QEMU are separate local inputs. Z7 startup changes guest RAM; natural power-on and complete camera hardware are not verified. Other Z models are not locally boot verified.
families.boot_gap_zh: 密钥和定制 QEMU 单独配置；Z7 辅助启动会修改 guest RAM，未验证自然开机与完整相机硬件；其他 Z 机型未验证启动。

families.status_en: Validated legacy FIR inspection and updater extraction; main image decryption and full ROM reconstruction are separate tasks.
families.status_zh: 校验旧款 FIR 容器并提取升级程序；主固件解密和完整 ROM 重建需分别研究。
families.boot_gap_en: Custom qemu-eos binary and model-specific ROM0/ROM1 dumps are needed. Stock QEMU virt/canon-a1100 does not establish EOS firmware support.
families.boot_gap_zh: 需要定制 qemu-eos 和机型对应 ROM0/ROM1；标准 QEMU virt/canon-a1100 不能证明支持 EOS 固件。

families.status_en: Plaintext container extraction with MD5 and CRC checks. This is not a general decryptor for other Insta360 cameras.
families.status_zh: 明文组件容器拆分，验证 MD5 和 CRC；该方法不等于支持其他 Insta360 机型的解密。
families.boot_gap_en: Ambarella board support, RTOS cooperation, storage and display. Encrypted Luna MWFI packages remain unsupported.
families.boot_gap_zh: 缺 Ambarella 板级适配、RTOS 协作、存储和显示；加密的 Luna MWFI 包尚未支持解密。
